$comment: Read-only reporting classification bands for `argus readiness` (Mission Part 56, 2026-10-07). These bands only decide whether a pre-session checklist line prints PASS/WARN/FAIL — they never gate, throttle, approve, block, or otherwise influence any trading decision, threshold, or RiskEngine/OMS behavior. Per AGENTS.md working rules, classification numbers live here, not as TypeScript literals. Memory bands are NOT duplicated here: the memory check reuses processTelemetry.classifyRss() and config/observability.json's evidence-labeled memoryTelemetryWarning/CriticalRssMb. Missing keys fail closed to conservative defaults in code; never put secrets here.
